talks.teaser: Detecting Hardware Keyloggers details #days Security & Risk Conference: Fabian Mihailowitsch.
talks.summary: Demonstrates software techniques to detect inline PS/2 and USB hardware keyloggers using timing measurement and USB behavior analysis. talks.teaser: Apple iOS 4 Privacy explores #days Security & Risk Conference: Nicolas Seriot.
talks.summary: Nicolas Seriot demonstrates how App Store apps can harvest personal data without private APIs, including phone number, address book, email settings, keyboard cache, call history, Safari searches, and location via WiFi or cell caches. Discusses App Store review bypass techniques and argues for improved sandboxing and applicative firewall-style user controls.
